title: Oozy Silky Malaysian Rice Bowl
description: A sour, silky, kid-friendly rice bowl that blends coconut milk, tamarind, and fermented sauces in a bamboo tray for a gluten-free feast.
instructions: Rinse the jasmine rice until the water runs clear, then soak it for 20 minutes.
Drain the rice and transfer it to a steamer basket; steam over simmering water for 15 minutes until fluffy.

In a saucepan, combine coconut milk, tamarind paste, vin-santo sauce, ferment-jang jam, grated ginger, minced garlic, and sesame oil; heat over medium until the mixture is hot but not boiling, stirring constantly.
Remove the sauce from heat and stir in lime juice.
Spread the cooked rice evenly in a bamboo tray, then pour the warm sauce over the rice, letting it soak for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro and crushed roasted peanuts over the rice.
Gently fold the rice and sauce together in the tray to create a silky, saucy layer.
Serve the bowl warm, optionally providing extra lime wedges for kids to squeeze.
